name: to-geojson
reference: Input: vector 01 (asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper). lat 482000000 * 1 / 10000000 = 48.2, lon 11.5, course 900 * 1 / 10 = 90, speed_ms 500 * 1 / 100 = 5 (ruling 1 of 0.5); uid "12345" derived from stationID 12345 by text_of (model/etsicam.def). The geojson pack writes geometry, then properties course and speed_ms in field-line order, then id (ruling 4 of 0.1.1); hae is absent, so coordinates are [lon, lat]; the etsicam keys have no geojson line. Derived without an engine.; the position is a raw key (pack.md), so none is carried; heading and speed too
